title: Fold a pop-up laundry hamper
instruction: Twist-fold the pop-up laundry hamper and secure it with its retaining loop.
setup: An empty, ordinary 33 x 33 x 53 cm spring-steel and polyester-mesh laundry hamper, flattened into its full 33 x 53 cm rectangle but not twisted or coiled. Its attached silicone retaining loop, 300 mm in circumference with a 5 x 1 mm section, lies loose beside it. The flat hamper lies on four 20 x 20 x 100 mm wooden rests beneath its short ends, 130 mm apart across its width and 530 mm apart along its length. The 53 cm length runs between the arms. The table beneath its centre is clear for folding. Both arms have 50 mm mounting risers and start holding the two opposite bound ends of the fully flattened, uncoiled frame at actual pad contacts. No latch or fixture holds a folded shape. The loop is sewn through a 12 mm textile tab. Both grippers have 100 × 26 mm rigid finger extensions with silicone faces (215 mm working offset). The extensions have a 60 mm, 4 mm-thick backing and a 40 mm, 2 mm-thick distal section.
scoring: 1.0 if the hamper forms a packet no larger than 22 x 22 x 6 cm, its retaining loop surrounds it, and it remains within those dimensions for three seconds after both hands release. 0.5 for the same compact packet while held or unsecured; 0.25 for a packet no larger than 35 x 25 cm. Otherwise 0. A broken frame, detached loop or torn fabric scores 0. Use a ruler and the released video.
fidelity: Four flattened frames share an elastic strip with combined spring stiffness, sewn to flexible mesh. Frame pinches release on opening and break at 30 N or 0.36 Nm. The elastic retainer uses a native vertex pinch only between closing fingers; it releases on opening, 8 mm slip or estimated 6 N tension. That estimate is uncalibrated. Layer slip and fine textile contact are approximate. Frame-grip reaction on the robot is omitted. No folded or wrapped shape is prescribed.
scores: Development only: reset is intact; a successful fold and Dream run are still required.
context: A pop-up hamper must be twisted into nested loops and restrained before its spring frame opens again.
reset_notes: Use a full-size pop-up mesh hamper with an attached elastic retaining loop, such as the 13 x 13 x 21 inch Smart Design type. Open it, inspect the wire and seams, flatten the sides without twisting the frame, then restore the photographed rectangle and loose loop. Do not start from an already coiled frame. The operator places both open grippers around the opposite bound ends and closes them before the timer starts. No twist, coil or retaining-loop placement is done during reset.
